# MSN

> Microsoft’s web portal for news, weather, sports, entertainment, lifestyle content, and web-based services.

MSN aggregates editorial content and service experiences across Microsoft properties, including news, weather, finance, health, games, and shopping. It also provides localized editions and topic hubs for major categories and current events.

## Home and Core Navigation
- [MSN Home](https://www.msn.com/): Main MSN portal with personalized news, services, and featured content.
- [News](https://www.msn.com/en-us/news): Central news hub covering top stories, politics, world, and local reporting.
- [Weather](https://www.msn.com/en-us/weather): Weather forecasts, radar, maps, and severe weather updates.
- [Sports](https://www.msn.com/en-us/sports): Sports headlines, scores, schedules, and league coverage.
- [Entertainment](https://www.msn.com/en-us/entertainment): Celebrity, TV, movies, music, and pop culture coverage.
- [Money](https://www.msn.com/en-us/money): Finance news, markets, personal finance, and business coverage.
- [Health](https://www.msn.com/en-us/health): Health news, wellness topics, and medical information.
- [Lifestyle](https://www.msn.com/en-us/lifestyle): Food, travel, relationships, home, and style content.

## News and Current Affairs
- [US News](https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us): National news coverage focused on events across the United States.
- [World News](https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world): International reporting on global politics, conflicts, and major developments.
- [Politics](https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/politics): Political news, elections, policy, and government coverage.
- [Crime](https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/crime): Crime reporting, investigations, and public safety stories.
- [Technology News](https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/technology): Technology industry news, products, platforms, and digital trends.
- [Science News](https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/science): Science discoveries, research updates, and space-related coverage.

## Weather
- [Weather Home](https://www.msn.com/en-us/weather): Main weather experience with forecasts and local conditions.
- [Forecast](https://www.msn.com/en-us/weather/forecast): Multi-day forecast view with hourly and daily outlooks.
- [Maps](https://www.msn.com/en-us/weather/maps): Interactive weather maps showing radar and regional conditions.
- [Radar](https://www.msn.com/en-us/weather/maps/radar): Radar map for precipitation and storm tracking.
- [Severe Weather](https://www.msn.com/en-us/weather/maps/severeweather): Severe weather map for alerts and active conditions.
- [Snow](https://www.msn.com/en-us/weather/maps/snow): Snow map showing snowfall and winter weather patterns.

## Sports
- [Sports Home](https://www.msn.com/en-us/sports): Main sports page with headlines, scores, and featured leagues.
- [NFL](https://www.msn.com/en-us/sports/nfl): NFL news, scores, standings, and game coverage.
- [NBA](https://www.msn.com/en-us/sports/nba): NBA news, scores, standings, and basketball analysis.
- [MLB](https://www.msn.com/en-us/sports/mlb): MLB news, scores, standings, and baseball coverage.
- [NHL](https://www.msn.com/en-us/sports/nhl): NHL news, scores, standings, and hockey updates.
- [NCAAF](https://www.msn.com/en-us/sports/ncaaf): College football news, rankings, and game coverage.
- [Soccer](https://www.msn.com/en-us/sports/soccer): Soccer news, scores, leagues, and tournament coverage.

## Money and Finance
- [Money Home](https://www.msn.com/en-us/money): Finance portal for markets, business, and personal finance topics.
- [Markets](https://www.msn.com/en-us/money/markets): Market news, indexes, stocks, and investing updates.
- [Personal Finance](https://www.msn.com/en-us/money/personalfinance): Personal finance guidance on saving, debt, and budgeting.
- [Retirement](https://www.msn.com/en-us/money/retirement): Retirement planning, savings strategies, and benefits-related content.
- [Real Estate](https://www.msn.com/en-us/money/realestate): Housing market news, home buying, and real estate trends.
- [Small Business](https://www.msn.com/en-us/money/smallbusiness): Small business news, operations, and entrepreneurship coverage.

## Entertainment and Lifestyle
- [Entertainment Home](https://www.msn.com/en-us/entertainment): Entertainment news spanning celebrities, TV, film, and music.
- [Celebrity](https://www.msn.com/en-us/entertainment/celebrity): Celebrity news, interviews, and trending stories.
- [TV](https://www.msn.com/en-us/entertainment/tv): Television news, streaming updates, and show coverage.
- [Movies](https://www.msn.com/en-us/entertainment/movies): Film news, trailers, releases, and movie features.
- [Music](https://www.msn.com/en-us/entertainment/music): Music news, artists, releases, and industry stories.
- [Lifestyle Home](https://www.msn.com/en-us/lifestyle): Lifestyle coverage across home, food, travel, and relationships.
- [Travel](https://www.msn.com/en-us/travel): Travel inspiration, destination guides, and trip-related articles.
- [Food and Drink](https://www.msn.com/en-us/foodanddrink): Recipes, cooking tips, and food news.

## Health
- [Health Home](https://www.msn.com/en-us/health): Health portal with wellness, conditions, and medical news.
- [Wellness](https://www.msn.com/en-us/health/wellness): Wellness guidance on fitness, habits, and healthy living.
- [Medical](https://www.msn.com/en-us/health/medical): Medical news, conditions, treatments, and healthcare topics.
- [Nutrition](https://www.msn.com/en-us/health/nutrition): Nutrition advice, diet topics, and healthy eating content.
- [Mind and Body](https://www.msn.com/en-us/health/mindandbody): Mental and physical wellbeing stories and practical guidance.

## Shopping and Deals
- [Shopping](https://www.msn.com/en-us/shopping): Shopping hub with product discovery, trends, and buying guides.
- [Deals](https://www.msn.com/en-us/shopping/deals): Deal-focused shopping content and discounted product highlights.
- [Gift Guides](https://www.msn.com/en-us/shopping/gift-guide): Curated gift recommendations for seasonal and special occasions.
- [Style and Beauty](https://www.msn.com/en-us/lifestyle/style): Style, fashion, and beauty-related lifestyle coverage.

## Games
- [MSN Games Categories](https://zone.msn.com/en/categories): Main categories page for browser-based MSN games.
- [Microsoft Solitaire Collection](https://zone.msn.com/en-us/games/microsoft-solitaire-collection): Browser play page for Microsoft Solitaire Collection.
- [Microsoft Mahjong](https://zone.msn.com/en-us/games/microsoft-mahjong): Browser play page for Microsoft Mahjong.
- [Microsoft Jewel](https://zone.msn.com/en-us/games/microsoft-jewel): Browser play page for Microsoft Jewel.
- [TextTwist 2](https://zone.msn.com/en-us/games/texttwist-2): Browser play page for the TextTwist 2 word game.
- [Mahjongg Dimensions](https://zone.msn.com/en-us/games/mahjongg-dimensions): Browser play page for the 3D tile-matching puzzle game.

## Regional Editions
- [MSN United States](https://www.msn.com/en-us): US English edition of the MSN portal.
- [MSN United Kingdom](https://www.msn.com/en-gb): UK English edition with localized news and services.
- [MSN Canada](https://www.msn.com/en-ca): Canadian English edition with regional coverage and content.
- [MSN Australia](https://www.msn.com/en-au): Australian edition with local news, weather, and lifestyle.
- [MSN India](https://www.msn.com/en-in): Indian English edition with localized headlines and features.
- [MSN France](https://www.msn.com/fr-fr): French edition of MSN with localized content and navigation.
